faqs.question: How long does a typical Shopify Development engagement take?
faqs.answer: Theme builds and migrations commonly take 4–10 weeks. Shopify Plus or complex app ecosystems can run 8–16 weeks.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We collaborate with your merchants, marketers, and apps stack — and we extend Shopify rather than fighting it.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: Conversion rate, speed, checkout completion, AOV, and operational efficiency for merchandising updates.

faqs.question: New store, redesign, or migration?
faqs.answer: All three. We handle theme development, UX redesigns, and migrations from WooCommerce or other platforms with SEO redirects.

faqs.question: Shopify Plus experience?
faqs.answer: Yes — checkout extensibility, B2B features, scripting/workflows, and performance patterns suited to higher volume brands.

faqs.question: Custom apps when needed?
faqs.answer: When native apps fall short. We build lightweight apps/integrations for unique pricing, subscriptions, or ops workflows.

faqs.question: How do you protect SEO during rebuilds?
faqs.answer: URL mapping, redirect plans, metadata parity, structured data, and post-launch crawl monitoring.

faqs.question: Can marketers edit pages easily?
faqs.answer: We set up sections, metafields, and content models so merchandising does not require a developer for routine updates.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Share your catalog size, apps, and goals. We propose architecture, timeline, and a phased launch plan.

faqs.question: Who builds the store?
faqs.answer: Shopify developers + UX, with QA on real devices and a structured UAT checklist before go-live.
